description: "No Quarter!" by Captain Mayne Reid is a historical novel written in the late 19th century. Set against the backdrop of the English Civil War, the story explores themes of loyalty, power struggles, and the concept of kingship through interactions among characters such as King Charles I and his wife Henrietta, alongside other historical figures.
